name: @octocodeai/octocode-native
description: Native Octocode tool runtime and command-line interface
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.build:all: yarn build:darwin-arm64 && yarn build:darwin-x64 && yarn build:linux-x64-gnu && yarn build:linux-x64-musl && yarn build:linux-arm64-gnu && yarn build:windows-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs darwin-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs darwin-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64-gnu: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-arm64-gnu
scripts.build:linux-x64-gnu: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-x64-gnu
scripts.build:linux-x64-musl: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-x64-musl
scripts.build:windows-x64: cargo build --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs win32-x64-msvc
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
